blocks.title: Expenses and budget
blocks.text: Expenses are the costs of running a business, such as rent, utilities, salaries and raw materials. A budget is a plan estimating how much money each area will need.
Comparing the budget with actual spending shows whether the bakery is overspending or saving.

blocks.prompt: Class activity: make a budget for a small business you would like to start. If utilities turn out Rs 30,000 higher than planned for the bakery, what are two ways to adjust?
blocks.explanation: Cut another item, for example buy ingredients in bulk more cheaply, or raise income, for example adjust prices or sell more; otherwise the total becomes Rs 780,000.

items: Budget: planned spending by item (bakery total Rs 750,000); compare with actual.
